title: Loot Items
description: The list of loot items. Each entry describes one item and what to do with it. Run `npm run validate` after editing loot.json to check your changes.

id.description: Unique key for this entry. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only. Usually the name in lowercase with dashes, e.g. "Cap [1]" -> "cap-1".

name.description: Item name as shown in game. Include slots in brackets for equipment, e.g. "Cap [1]".

itemId.description: The item's numeric ID in the game database. Use null if unknown.

itemType.description: What kind of item it is in game. Filled in from the Hercules item database.

actions.description: What to do with this item. An item can have several actions. Leave empty ([]) if not decided yet.

categories.description: What the item is used for. An item can be in several categories.

uses.description: What this item is needed for, and how many. e.g. [{ "for": "Mystic Rose", "qty": 10 }]. Use "qty": null when the amount varies.

for.description: The headgear, quest, pet evolution, etc.

qty.description: How many are needed, or null if it varies.

notes.description: Anything else worth knowing that isn't a 'use', e.g. "Isis Taming Item" or "+10 DEX Food".

links.description: Helpful links for this item (quest guides, wiki pages).

avgVend.description: Average price (zeny) players sell this for in vending shops. null = no data yet (don't use 0).

avgWhobuy.description: Average price (zeny) players pay when buying this through @whobuy. null = no data yet (don't use 0).

npcSellPrice.description: Zeny you get selling one to an NPC with Overcharge level 10. null = unknown.

npcBuyable.description: Can you buy this from an NPC? "yes", "no", "npc-only" (only obtainable from an NPC), or null if unknown.

lastVerified.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) someone last checked this entry on the live server. null = never verified.

verificationNotes.description: Who verified it and how, e.g. "Checked vend prices in Prontera, 3 shops".

action.description: Allowed actions. To add a new one, add it here AND in src/utils/labels.js (for its display name and color).

category.description: Allowed categories: what the item is used for. To add a new one, add it here. (Consumable / Equipment / Misc are item types, not categories.)
